metadata.description: Claude Code plugins: HTML rendering, session naming, and workflow helpers.

plugins.name: to-html
plugins.description: Content-aware HTML rendering for Claude Code. `/to-html` toggles it on; every substantive reply is classified and rendered with the right template (plan, comparison, explainer, prose). Trivial replies are skipped.

plugins.name: sesh
plugins.description: Auto-names Claude Code sessions based on conversation context. Silent UserPromptSubmit hook that injects a one-time naming instruction after a few user messages.
